items.t: Orange County breaks ground on new center for women, children experiencing homelessness
items.x: A new center in Orlando will provide housing, health care, and community services for women and children in need, expanding service capacity by up to 50%.

items.t: Man arrested, charged with murder in 2025 shooting, Orlando police say
items.x: Marcus Antoinne Lambert was charged with second-degree murder in a 2025 homicide investigation.

items.t: Florida Highway Patrol trooper airlifted after crash on SR 429 in Orange County
items.x: A Florida Highway Patrol trooper and a pickup truck driver were seriously injured in a crash involving a marked patrol vehicle in a construction zone on State Road 429 in Orange County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

items.t: Orlando Police make breakthrough in 2025 homicide investigation
items.x: Marcus Antoinne Lambert, 65, was charged with second-degree murder for the 2025 killing of Nevaeh Shyanna Marie Zeigler.

items.t: Genitorturers make Halloween heavy in Orlando
items.x: Cult legends the Genitorturers are returning to their birthplace of Orlando to punish us so good again with their BDSM rock spectacle.

items.t: Orlando PlayFest opens this weekend with bold new dramatic works
items.x: If you’re all spooky season’d out and instead want to spend Halloween taking in some terrifyingly good new theatrical works, the first weekend of PlayFest is where you need to be. You’ll be treated to staged readings of six plays and get…

items.t: Orlando musicians dress up as their fav bands for Halloween cover shows
items.x: The local institution that is Psycho ’78 doing their annual full-bore Misfits set is always welcome; a GG Allin tribute act called GG Ellin has us intrigued despite ourselves; and hardcore firebrands M.A.C.E. doing a Bauhaus (!) tribute…

items.t: Orlando Museum of Arts gets spooky with Shadows in the Galleries
items.x: The Halloween event is a first for Orlando Museum of Art and they’re going all out with a costume contest, themed drinks, light bites, a DJ (and attendant dancing) and a photobooth.

items.t: Runner who competed in first Orlando half marathon helping others find their stride 50 years later
items.x: 50 years. Countless miles. One lasting love of running. 🏃‍♂️ Meet the man who’s been part of Orlando’s half marathon history since day one.

items.t: Florida trooper, driver injured in SR-429 crash in Orange County, FHP says
items.x: A Florida Highway Patrol trooper and another driver were injured Tuesday night in a crash on State Road 429 in Orange County, according to FHP.

items.t: FHP trooper airlifted to hospital after patrol car hit in Orange County construction zone
items.x: An FHP trooper was airlifted to hospital with serious injuries after their patrol car hit in SR-429 construction zone on Tuesday night.

items.t: Court suggests Florida teacher shouldn’t be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk’s death
items.x: A Florida judge last week recommended dismissing a misconduct case against a Clay County teacher for a post celebrating Kirk's death.

items.t: Uthmeier says property risk-assessment company ‘is marketing fear to advance a climate activism agenda’
items.x: Florida has sued a company that issues climate change assessments of property risks including flooding that the state alleges are deceptive

items.t: Organist Cameron Carpenter conjures symphony of horror to soundtrack ‘Nosferatu’
items.x: Between the haunting shadows of Murnau’s Nosferatu and Carpenter’s esoteric accompaniment, this silent film promises to make plenty of noise.

items.t: The Nook celebrates its last night open with a Halloween funeral party
items.x: The Nook on Robinson is closing on Halloween night and, fittingly for a space that has never shied away from a good conceptual soiree, with a funeral-themed party.

items.t: Nick Shoulders is back on familiar ground with Halloween show at Tuffy’s
items.x: Arkansas country-music outsider Nick Shoulders has been coming through Central Florida so frequently lately that we may begin to expect it.

items.t: ‘Jodi,’ a rare Nanotyrannus fossil, sells for $47 million at Sotheby’s auction
items.x: Jodi fetched the second-highest price for dinosaur bones, behind only the $50.1 million for a T. rex fossil nicknamed “Gus” that was sold by Sotheby's earlier this year.
